description: feat/permanent-wounds (D-GH-2026-10-04-permanent-wounds): a DM imposes FOUR wounds in four different places on a Fighter — Bad Knee (leg), Withered Arm (arm), One-Eyed (eye), Brittle Bones (bones); three of them are wound-only entries no player can take. Each is DM-imposed, so: no '⛔ … only a DM can impose it' (the imposition marker is what lets a wound-only entry through), no 'both injure the same place' warning (four different slots), no cap warning and no AP (the player is paid nothing). EV-028 is the same-place case; EV-029 is a player-taken wound-only entry.
